Items.Title: Cloud Username
Items.Description: Your Somfy / Overkiz account e-mail address (Cloud mode only).

Items.Title: Cloud Password
Items.Description: Your Somfy / Overkiz account password (Cloud mode only).

Items.Title: Cloud Server
Items.Description: The Overkiz server your account belongs to (Cloud mode only).

Items.Title: Gateway IP Address
Items.Description: LAN IP address or hostname of your Overkiz-compatible gateway (Local mode only).

Items.Title: Local API Token
Items.Description: Developer-mode bearer token generated from your Somfy cloud account (Local mode only).

Items.Title: Room Groups
Items.Description: Optional. Group shades into rooms for simultaneous control. Format: RoomKey:Room Title=Shade1ApiLabel:Shade 1 Title,Shade2ApiLabel:Shade 2 Title; RoomKey2=Shade3ApiLabel. The part before ':' is the API/matching label; the optional part after ':' is the display name shown as the room title or subheading. Shade API labels must match the device names reported by the Overkiz gateway.

Items.Title: Shade Display Names
Items.Description: Optional. Override the title shown for individual shades. Format: ApiLabel:Display Name;ApiLabel2:Display Name2. The API label must match the device name reported by the Overkiz gateway exactly.
